Blendwell Chemicals, formed in 1990 near the Old Mint in Centurion, manufactures an extensive range of high-quality cleaning chemicals backed by international certifications, including its food-safe and certified eco-friendly lines. Its state-of-the-art premises include a dedicated paper plant producing toilet rolls, garage rolls, washroom rolls and folded paper towels alongside the chemical range.

The business is now part of Prime Cleaning Suppliers Gauteng, giving customers access to a far wider range of cleaning supplies, brooms, mops, cleaning cloths and equipment, plus Wetrok machines, chemicals and accessories, all available for delivery or collection in the Centurion area. Based in Louwlardia, Centurion, Blendwell Chemicals suits cleaning businesses and institutions wanting food-safe or eco-friendly chemicals and paper goods from one certified manufacturer.

Bolt & Engineering Distributors, in Waltloo, operates across eight product divisions covering fasteners, tools, bearings, welding and cutting equipment, health and safety gear, lifting equipment, paints and thinners, and oils and lubricants, backed by dedicated welding repair centres. Its Tshwane branch is one of nine outlets nationwide, alongside Wadeville, Klerksdorp, Welkom, Rustenburg, Lephalale, Middelburg, Burgersfort and Cape Town.

The company also exports its product range beyond South Africa's borders, giving it reach as both a local industrial distributor and an exporter. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, Bolt & Engineering Distributors is based in Waltloo, Pretoria, and suits industrial and engineering businesses needing fasteners, tools, bearings or safety equipment sourced from one distributor with national branch coverage.

BPC HR Solutions, based in The Willows Office Park, Pretoria, is a nationally recognised, SETA-accredited skills development and training provider delivering accredited learnerships and skills programmes that help organisations meet their BEE compliance goals through tailored, outcome-based learning. Its programmes run from Service Station Operations, Retail Supervision and Automotive Sales through to Automotive Manufacturing Assembly, Automotive Components Manufacturing and Furniture Making.

Retail-focused programmes cover roles such as Retail Supervisor, Retail Manager, Sales Assistant and Service Station Attendant, giving learners a path toward specific, job-ready roles rather than generic workplace skills. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4pm, BPC HR Solutions is based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, and suits businesses needing accredited training that counts toward BEE scorecards as much as individuals seeking a recognised qualification.

Brand Hub Solutions is a South African promotional products supplier offering branded corporate clothing, corporate gifts, headwear and custom print media designed to unify a business's identity under one reliable partner. Its product range runs across printing, outdoor and indoor display, winter wear and footwear, working with recognised brands including the Gary Player Collection, Slazenger, US Basic, Elevate, Biz Collection, Alex Varga, Okiyo and Urban Terrain.

The business draws on supplier factories such as AMROD and Barron that have been in the branded merchandise industry for many years, giving it access to established stock lines alongside its own custom work. Based in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, Brand Hub Solutions suits businesses wanting branded clothing, gifts and display items sourced from a single supplier rather than coordinating several separate printers.

Business Enhancement Partners, based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, has supported customers since 2020 as an independent partner for implementing and maintaining management systems based on ISO or Tailings Management System standards, including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 31000, ISO 45001 and the Global Industry Standard on Tailings Management. Its implementation work ranges from status assessments, which identify the gap between a client's existing system and the standard's requirements, to assisted implementations for clients lacking capacity, through to fully managed implementations taken all the way to third-party certification.

Once a system is in place, the firm's maintenance services keep it delivering ongoing benefit, supported by desktop audits, gap analysis audits, second-party audits and supplier audits. Based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, Business Enhancement Partners suits organisations needing an ISO or Tailings Management System built, maintained or audited by specialists rather than handled internally.

Cabac Engineering & Electrical, established in 2002 and based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, supplies electrical cable accessories and provides installation of low- to high-voltage joints and terminations, MV switchgear, miniature substations and ring main units. The business also offers skills transfer and training, passing on technical knowledge to client teams rather than only completing the installation itself.

That combination of supply, installation and training positions the business as a long-term technical partner for electrical infrastructure projects rather than a parts counter alone. Based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, Cabac Engineering & Electrical suits utilities and industrial clients needing electrical cable accessories and MV switchgear installed and maintained by a specialist provider.

This Cartridge Depot branch, at Atterbury Boulevard Shopping Centre in Faerie Glen, is a destination for premium printer cartridges, specialising in a diverse selection of remanufactured cartridges under the chain's own trademarked Eclipse brand alongside original equipment manufacturer cartridges. Its range is built to ensure compatibility and optimal printing results across all major printer brands, backed by printing paper and memory devices for customers needing more than just ink.

Staff provide personalised recommendations and attentive support to help customers find the right cartridge for their printer, whether they are a home user, a small business or a larger organisation, with both online and in-store shopping available. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, Saturdays from 8am to 2pm and Sundays from 9am to 1pm, this Cartridge Depot branch suits anyone in Pretoria East needing cartridges matched to their specific printer rather than guessing at compatibility.

Catering Shop Online imports and supplies catering equipment across categories including bakery equipment, butchery equipment, gas equipment, party equipment, processing equipment and refrigeration, serving small factories, hotels, restaurants, shops and home industries with nationwide delivery. Featured items range from gas and electric fryers and upright freezers to cake mixers and popcorn machines, alongside crane and wall-hanging scales for businesses needing to weigh stock.

The business runs monthly deals on selected catering essentials, giving regular customers a reason to check back for discounted equipment rather than paying full price every time. Open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm, Fridays from 8am to noon and 2pm to 4:30pm, and Saturdays from 8:30am to noon, Catering Shop Online is based in Lyttelton, Centurion, and suits commercial kitchens and home-based caterers needing equipment delivered rather than collected in person.

CBA Systems, based in Sinoville, Pretoria, provides domain and web hosting, website and web application hosting, and email hosting, giving clients control over their own infrastructure with support on hand to get it up and running. Its development team handles custom client requests across a variety of platforms, implementing the latest technology rather than working from a single fixed template.

The business also manages client applications and network infrastructure, incorporating a competitive level of security into that ongoing management rather than treating security as a one-off setup task. Based in Sinoville, Pretoria, CBA Systems suits businesses needing hosting, custom software development and network management handled by one IT provider rather than separate specialists for each.

CBS Logistics, based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, specialises in the bulk transportation of commodities across South Africa and into Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Botswana and Zambia, operating as a full-service, customer-centric transport management company rather than a logistics broker alone. Its versatile fleet, including side-tippers and dropsides, delivers more than 80,000 tons of commodities a month.

Beyond moving freight, the company offers insurance and risk management cover for loss, damage or legal disputes connected to a shipment, and its dedicated team tailors logistics solutions to complex transport needs across different industries. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, CBS Logistics suits businesses needing bulk commodities moved reliably across Southern African borders rather than within South Africa alone.

Centmark Systems, based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, is a gas detection specialist supplying, installing and calibrating portable and fixed gas detection systems, from a single personal monitor through to a fully monitored multi-zone industrial system. The company is the official South African representative for Kimessa and Inosent gas detection equipment, and its detectors cover a wide range of gases including LPG, methane, hydrogen sulphide, carbon dioxide and ammonia.

Its service side runs on a 6- or 12-month calibration cycle, with comprehensive certificates issued and records kept on file, and sensors replaced on the same visit at the workshop or on site. Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, Centmark Systems suits industrial, commercial and residential clients needing gas detection equipment supplied, installed and kept compliant through regular calibration.

Central Solar Supplies PTA, based in Samrand, Centurion, is a wholesale solar distributor supplying inverters, solar panels, batteries, complete solar kits and accessories to installers and resellers rather than directly to homeowners. Its range includes brands such as Huawei, LuxPower, Jinko Solar and Canadian Solar, giving installer customers a choice of established international manufacturers.

The business also offers financing options and technical support for both commercial and industrial customers, helping installers manage larger or more complex system specifications. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, Central Solar Supplies PTA is based in Brooklands Lifestyle Estate, Centurion, and suits solar installers and resellers wanting a wholesale supplier with financing and technical backup rather than buying components individually from several sources.

Centurion Chambers, also known as Centurion Advocates Chambers, provides spacious offices in Die Hoewes designed and furnished specifically for practising advocates, including a consulting room, wireless internet, photocopying and printing, a kitchen area and secure parking. Tenant advocates are registered members of the Legal Practice Council and practise across fields such as constitutional, administrative, mercantile and labour law.

Rather than the traditional advocates association model, where members bear the financial and administrative risk collectively, tenants at Centurion Chambers conclude agreements with a company offering practical offices at a fair, market-related price fixed by contract, while still enjoying the networking benefits of shared chambers. Based in Centurion Central, Centurion Chambers suits practising advocates wanting professional office facilities and peer networking without the administrative burden of running an association.

Chemical Process Technologies, based on a 10,000-square-metre industrial site in Waltloo, Pretoria, is a chemical synthesis company developing and commercialising competitive organic synthesis routes for fine chemicals and formulated end-user products. The company is a major supplier of formulated animal health products and also supplies intermediates to the pharmaceutical industry, a combination that positions it to potentially backward-integrate into manufacturing active pharmaceutical ingredients.

With 75 permanent employees manufacturing to Good Manufacturing Practice quality norms and ISO 9001:2015 certification, the company exports its products to more than 15 countries across Europe, North and South America, Africa and Asia. Based in Waltloo, Pretoria, Chemical Process Technologies suits pharmaceutical, animal health and chemical industry clients needing synthesised fine chemicals produced to an internationally certified standard.

Citatim Cabling, operating since 1999 from Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, designs, installs and maintains structured network cabling, fibre optic and CCTV infrastructure for businesses across Pretoria, Gauteng and neighbouring provinces. Its structured cabling work covers Cat6 and Cat6A as well as Cat5 and Cat5E installations, while its fibre optic team handles backbone installations, splicing, termination and testing for scalable ISP, data centre and enterprise networks.

The company also offers cabinet cleanups and network upgrades, reorganising and labelling existing cabling and removing redundant or faulty runs, and operates as a white-label outsourced cabling partner for IT companies, MSPs and ISPs wanting to subcontract installation work. Based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, Citatim Cabling suits businesses needing structured cabling, fibre or CCTV infrastructure installed by a long-established specialist rather than a general electrician.

Compliance Hub Consulting, founded in 2012, serves South African businesses from Claudius, Pretoria, through a national sales force of associates bringing more than 35 years of combined experience from leading agencies to each client's compliance needs. Its holistic approach spans B-BBEE consulting, corporate compliance, employment equity, and enterprise supplier development and procurement.

The firm also advises on human resources, ownership and trust solutions, and skills development and SDF submissions, treating a client's compliance needs as connected rather than handling each requirement in isolation. Based in Claudius, Pretoria, Compliance Hub Consulting suits businesses of any size wanting one national consultancy across B-BBEE, employment equity and broader corporate compliance rather than separate specialists for each.

Corporate Configurations Business Consultancy, based in the Erasmuskloof area of Pretoria, runs an insightful discovery programme of up to three days designed to uncover the extraordinary in otherwise ordinary organisations, groups and individuals. The programme cost-effectively involves executive leadership, operations management and staff together, unearthing what makes a business tick and recommending contextual change to strategically drive and operationally manage its resources.

Its engagement builds on the fundamental beneficiary and fiduciary relationship inherent in every organisation, giving leadership and individual staff a common framework to look ahead and consider their respective roles. Delivery typically takes the form of non-typical, reflective, company-specific team-building and strategy sessions rather than a standard off-the-shelf workshop. Based in Candlewoods Estate, Pretoria, Corporate Configurations suits organisations wanting a structured, multi-day diagnostic process rather than a single afternoon strategy session.

Culmen Konsultante, established in 1991 and based in Silverton, Pretoria, is a 100% Black South African-owned company offering pressure vessel testing and certification, including non-destructive testing, leak detection and pressure safety valve assessments. Its load testing and maintenance certification covers lifting and handling equipment used in manufacturing, from monorail structures and jib cranes to overhead travelling cranes, vehicle lifts and mobile cranes.

With more than 33 years of experience and over 999 completed projects, the company also provides project-specific support for infrastructure such as bridges, high-rises and industrial facilities, alongside accredited operator training and civil and mechanical engineering services. Open Monday to Friday from 7am to 4:30pm, Culmen Konsultante is based in Brummeria, Pretoria, and suits manufacturers and infrastructure projects needing lifting equipment tested, certified and maintained to a recognised standard.

Custom Coding, based in Raslouw, Centurion, draws on 25 years of software development experience to build custom software in numerous programming languages, from concept through to deployment. Its own product line includes NeverOffice Cloud, Chrome Hair Salon Software, Counsel Solutions for the legal profession, and a lifting certificates product, alongside WordPress and WooCommerce website builds and Windows desktop application development.

The company also runs digital marketing covering SEO and social media, provides AI consulting, and offers software maintenance and support even for systems it did not originally build, including taking over a client's software when the original developer is no longer available. Based in Raslouw, Centurion, Custom Coding suits businesses needing bespoke software built from scratch as well as those whose existing developer has moved on.

CWC, trading as Centurion Wall Coatings or "The Gamazine Paint Factory," manufactures gamazine plaster paint, a wall coating made of thick plastered crushed marble, sand and quartz stone chips available in various colours. Its durability can last up to 20 years, compared with the two to five years between repaints that a standard paint job typically needs, significantly cutting maintenance costs for homeowners and landlords.

Alongside gamazine paint, the company manufactures and sells Glamour Coat, PVC panels, cornices and wallpaper, serving both contractors and members of the public directly from its factory and store. Based in Kloofsig, Centurion, CWC suits homeowners and contractors wanting a long-lasting decorative wall finish rather than conventional paint needing repainting every few years.

Diabor, founded in 1983 and still family-managed, operates a fleet of 20 core-drilling rigs for geotechnical investigations covering dam walls, construction foundations, marine and harbour work, quarries, tunnels, bridges, piling investigations and pipelines, alongside exploration drilling for the mining industry. The company's stated vision is to become the preferred geotechnical and exploration drilling company in Sub-Saharan Africa.

Its projects have reached well beyond South Africa into Botswana, Zimbabwe, Eswatini, Lesotho, Zambia, Angola, Mozambique, Namibia, Liberia, Malawi, Kenya and the DRC, supported by a team of experienced, highly trained staff spanning project management, production supervision, drilling and administration. Based in Klerksoord, Pretoria, Diabor suits mining and construction clients needing geotechnical or exploration drilling carried out across multiple African countries.

Die Skaapkraal Gasteplaas, on a working sheep farm south of Pretoria, was restored from an old skaapkraal (sheep kraal) into a guest house set within the Cullinan Nature Reserve landscape, offering panoramic views over grass fields and dams. Its 12 farmstyle bedrooms are each uniquely decorated, named after a sheep breed, and come en suite with fresh linens and towels, alongside a communal kitchen for self-catering guests.

Guests can relax on the outdoor patio or gather around the braai pit, and the property especially welcomes kids' birthday parties thanks to its space for outdoor activities, alongside birdwatching, bass fishing, horse riding and mountain biking on the farm. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm and weekends from 10am to 2pm, Die Skaapkraal Gasteplaas is based in Donkerhoek and suits families and groups wanting a rustic farm escape close to Pretoria rather than a conventional hotel stay.

DSV Logistics' Kosmosdal branch in Centurion is part of DSV, a Danish multinational transport and logistics company offering road, air and sea freight forwarding alongside contract logistics, warehousing and end-to-end supply chain management. Clients can quote, book and manage shipments through DSV's own digital platforms, track shipments in real time, and connect their own systems through API and EDI integration.

The group serves industries including automotive, technology, healthcare, industrial, consumer goods and aerospace, each with tailored supply chain solutions suited to that sector's specific compliance and timing requirements. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, DSV Logistics' Kosmosdal branch is based in Centurion and suits businesses needing freight forwarding or contract logistics backed by a global network rather than a purely local operator.

Dugas Projects and Trading, established in 2015 and based in Klerksoord, Akasia, engineers and manufactures low- and medium-voltage switchgear panels for the electrical construction industry, backed by four directors and 52% Black ownership. Its PLC, SCADA and HMI solutions and programming work support industrial automation projects alongside its core switchgear manufacturing.

The company supplies all types of switchgear to the mining, food and general industrial sectors, and provides installation, commissioning and ongoing maintenance on low- and medium-voltage substations once equipment is in place. Based in Klerksoord, Akasia, Dugas Projects and Trading suits mining, food and industrial clients needing switchgear manufactured, installed and maintained by the same engineering team.

Fowkes Bros has distributed engineering and industrial supplies across South Africa since 1897, stocking more than 18,000 product lines across 190 brands through its Rosslyn branch and five others nationwide. Its catalogue spans protective and repair products, rivets and fixings, soldering tools, welding equipment, abrasives, adhesives and sealants, air tools, bolts, nuts and screws, cutting and threading tools, and heavy machinery.

Credit account holders benefit from delivery savings, and the company's online catalogue lets tradespeople check stock and pricing before visiting a store in person. Open Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Fridays from 7:30am to 2pm, closed Saturdays, Fowkes Bros' Rosslyn branch is based in Akasia, Pretoria, and suits tradespeople and industrial buyers needing engineering supplies from a distributor with more than a century of trading history.

Gem Manufacturers, originally founded as Siemens Tools, Metals and Plastics in the late 1990s through a management buyout, has served the electrical, telecoms, food packaging, construction and automotive industries for more than 21 years from its Pretoria plant. The company produces pressed metal and injection-moulded plastic components, supported by a specialised toolmaking and design workshop and a surface treatment facility that plates millions of components.

Its 3,500 square metre facility houses 80 employees and top-of-the-line equipment, and the business has expanded internationally since 2000, now supplying clients across North America, Europe and Asia while preserving the precision-engineering values it inherited from its Siemens origins. Based in Silverton, Pretoria, Gem Manufacturers suits electrical, automotive and packaging clients needing pressed metal or injection-moulded components manufactured to precision tolerances.

Honeyfields Chocolate and Cone Factory, established in 1987 from a Sunnyside ice cream parlour, manufactures sugar cones, wafer baskets, melting chocolate and sprinkles in a GFSI and HACCP certified, Halaal and Kosher certified plant in Lyttelton. Its range extends into chocolate cake spread, chunky chocolate chips, chocolate nibs and bulk ice cream dips sold in 5kg and 20kg tubs for commercial kitchens.

The company exports to Europe and the Middle East alongside its domestic trade, giving it a reach beyond the typical local confectionery manufacturer. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, Honeyfields is based in Lyttelton, Centurion, and suits ice cream parlours, bakeries and confectioners needing cones, chocolate and toppings sourced from one certified manufacturer.

Lilla Van Der Merwe Accountants Inc has operated in Pretoria North since 1 June 1990, servicing more than 1,200 clients ranging from sole proprietors and individuals to companies, close corporations, trusts and non-profit organisations. Its accounting services cover monthly bookkeeping, payroll and income tax, while its administrative services handle CIPC registrations and amendments and the filing of annual returns.

On the compliance side, the practice assists with SARS, COIDA/RMA and Department of Labour requirements, helping clients stay on the right side of regulatory bodies rather than discovering a problem after the fact. As an Approved Training Centre registered with the South African Institute of Professional Accountants, the firm also trains the next generation of accountants. Based in Florauna, Pretoria, Lilla Van Der Merwe Accountants Inc suits businesses and individuals needing accounting, administrative and compliance services from one long-established practice.

LKTT Event Management & Catering, registered since 2013 and based in Lotus Gardens, has built up more than a decade in the events and catering business, offering wedding coordination and catering alongside hire of tents, tables, linen, chair covers and decor. That hire range covers both the structural side of an event and its finishing touches, letting clients source everything from one supplier rather than several separate hire companies.

The business caters for both adult functions and children's events, adjusting its coordination and decor approach to suit the occasion rather than offering a single standard package. Based in Lotus Gardens, Pretoria, LKTT Event Management & Catering suits couples planning a wedding as much as families organising a children's party needing tents, tables and catering handled together.

LNDR Business Credit, based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, funds South African SMEs that have been trading for six months or more, offering purchase order and tender funding so businesses can fulfil orders and pay suppliers with upfront capital rather than losing the opportunity to delays. Its invoice discounting product lets businesses unlock working capital by borrowing against unpaid invoices rather than waiting on customers to settle.

Short-term business loans cover gaps between project stages or payments, with the business promising fast turnaround offers in under 48 hours and direct access to its own credit investigators rather than an automated application process. Based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, LNDR Business Credit suits SMEs in retail, services, manufacturing and construction needing fast, flexible funding rather than a slow bank application process.

Macmobile Software, founded in 2004 and based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, builds route-to-market technology for the FMCG and distribution sector, used by businesses ranging from major retail chains to township spaza shops. Its field sales automation software gives field teams real-time visibility and cuts wasted travel time and unproductive routes, while its image recognition tools and beverage field sales software address specific industry needs.

The company's platform also covers B2B eCommerce, distribution management, merchandising management and warehouse management, standardising how a team works in the field with real-time updates rather than relying on manual processes and delayed reports. With installations built up across Africa over more than 15 years, Macmobile Software is based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, and suits FMCG and distribution businesses wanting to replace manual field processes with a connected, trackable system.

Mad Packaging and Manufacturing, founded in 2005 by two packaging-industry veterans with a combined 40 years of experience in packaging and flexographic printing, offers full contract packaging services in Donkerhoek. Its complete service covers developing sachets, sourcing and printing packaging materials, filling, flow-wrapping or shrink-wrapping, packing into display units and boxing a product ready for dispatch to a wholesale or retail outlet.

The business manufactures powder, liquid, tablet and cream sachets alongside bottle filling, and has recently invested in its own powder manufacturing plant to expand that side of the operation, all carried out under FSA accreditation and GMP quality standards. Open Monday to Thursday from 7am to 5pm and Fridays from 7am to 4pm, Mad Packaging and Manufacturing is based in Donkerhoek, Pretoria, and suits brands needing a contract packer that can source materials, fill and finish a product end to end.

Magna Business Consulting, headquartered in Lynnwood, draws on specialists across industrial engineering, business administration, electronic and civil engineering, statistics, computer science and psychology to deliver systems design, project management, and education and training consulting. Its named products include TRAFMAN and CBRTS for traffic and transportation, REMCOM, and sector-specific systems such as EduFundi for education and Intelligent Medic for healthcare, alongside vehicle registration, driver licensing, weighbridge and biometric systems.

The firm's services span custom information systems, management and strategy consulting, operations research, organisational analysis, process and financial analysis, and training for sustainability, applied across sectors including government, mining, ports, agriculture and financial services. Open Monday to Thursday from 7am to 6pm, Magna Business Consulting suits government bodies and large organisations needing both custom software systems and the management consulting to implement them.

MATHEBULA MF ATTORNEYS INC, founded by a young admitted attorney of the High Court of South Africa, offers services spanning labour, corporate, commercial and immigration law from its Thatch Hill Estate office in Centurion. The firm also handles conveyancing, family law and divorce matters, giving it a spread across both commercial and personal legal work rather than a single narrow specialism.

That combination suits clients who might otherwise need to engage separate firms for a business matter and a personal one, consolidating both under one practice. Based in Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, MATHEBULA MF ATTORNEYS INC suits individuals needing family law or conveyancing support as much as businesses needing labour, corporate or commercial law advice.

Matla Quantity Surveyors, registered with the Council of South African Quantity Surveyors and based in Lynnwood Glen, traces its roots to a practice founded in 1981, building its service around being punctual, precise and professional on every project. The practice's full range of specialised quantity surveying services covers a project from inception and design through construction administration to the final account.

Its dedicated project management service reflects what the firm describes as a genuine passion for the profession, supported by a team the practice says is effective, competent and boasts vast industry experience. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Matla Quantity Surveyors suits developers and contractors needing cost control and quantity surveying carried through an entire project rather than at isolated stages.

Milkor Group, headquartered in Diamond Park, Hennopspark, is a South African defence manufacturer established in 1980, best known for its 40mm calibre weapons range including the MK1S, MK1L, UBGL, Stopper Convertible and Super Six multiple grenade launcher, used in more than 50 countries. The company has since expanded across air, land, sea and cyber defence systems, including the Milkor 380 intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance platform.

Its land division builds the BushCat, Frontier and Vanguard armoured personnel carriers for tough terrain, while its Milkor Commander vessel serves maritime security roles for navy, coast guard and police forces, each engineered with an emphasis on safety and mission success. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, Milkor Group suits defence and security forces needing air, land, sea, weapons or cyber capability from a single established manufacturer.

Mining And Surface Certification (MASC), based in Hennopspark, is the leading provider of Ex explosion-protection certification and hazardous location compliance services in Southern Africa, drawing on more than 100 years of combined team expertise across more than 16,000 successful assessments. Its IECEx certification work covers a wide range of Ex techniques, helping equipment meet global standards for safety and reliability across the mining and manufacturing sectors.

The company offers a free 20-minute consultation to help new clients understand the certification process before committing, and its batch inspection service is built for quick turnaround so certified products reach clients on schedule. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, MASC suits mining and manufacturing operators needing hazardous location equipment certified and tested to recognised international standards.

ML Tree Felling Pretoria, based in Rietfontein, offers a full range of tree care services including emergency tree felling, stump grinding and removal, tree trimming and thinning, hedge trimming, and palm tree pruning and removal. Emergency callouts matter for trees that have become a hazard after a storm or through disease, rather than planned maintenance work alone.

Alongside tree care, the business provides truck hire and rubble removal, useful for clients needing felled material or garden waste cleared from the property once the work is done. Based in Rietfontein, Pretoria, ML Tree Felling Pretoria suits homeowners and property managers needing both the tree work and the resulting cleanup handled by the same team.

MP Solar has installed residential and commercial solar systems across Pretoria and the greater Gauteng area since 2015, backing its certified work with equipment warranties of ten years or more. Alongside outright installation, the company now offers solar on a simple monthly subscription with no upfront cost, using a satellite view of a customer's own roof to size a system to their usage and project savings over five years as electricity tariffs keep climbing.

Customers can cancel or upgrade a subscription plan at any time, with the system fully managed and insured by MP Solar throughout, and the company also offers solar geyser solutions for households wanting to cut hot-water costs specifically. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, MP Solar is based in Boekenhoutskloof, Pretoria, and suits households wanting a no-capital-outlay subscription as much as those wanting to buy a system outright.

Nimbus Water, based in Les Marais, supplies and services water purification and filtration equipment capable of treating municipal, borehole, river, dam, grey and wastewater, extending from standard filtration to custom reverse osmosis, UV and ozone treatment systems. That range lets the business take on both straightforward drinking-water filtration and more complex industrial or specialised wastewater problems.

The company also supplies rainwater harvesting and storage solutions, giving clients an option to capture and reuse rainwater alongside treating water they already have on site. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4pm and Saturdays from 8:30am to 1pm, closed Sundays, Nimbus Water is based in Les Marais, Pretoria, and suits households and businesses needing water treated to a specific standard rather than a generic off-the-shelf filter.

Northern Food Ingredients, family-owned and trading since 2006, wholesales food ingredients and butchery requisites from Pretoria North to caterers, restaurants, hotels, butcheries, retail stores and sauce manufacturers across Northern Gauteng, Mpumalanga, North West and Limpopo. Its core range covers instant packs, herbs and spices, sauces, sausage casings and baking ingredients, supplying the raw materials food businesses build their own menus and products around.

Under its own Big 5 Foods retail range, the company sells seasonings and sauces including a Steakhouse Grill and a Smokey BBQ Sauce, giving it both a bulk wholesale line and a branded retail product for businesses wanting to resell. Based in Pretoria North, Northern Food Ingredients suits food service businesses across four provinces needing ingredients and butchery supplies from one established regional wholesaler.

Olive Designs & Web, based in Erasmia, Centurion, builds websites from a basic single page through to custom e-commerce stores, describing itself as a South African company with an international approach to design and marketing. Its digital marketing work covers social media management aimed at growing an engaged following, alongside Google Ads and Facebook Ads campaigns that the company analyses and manages to track return on investment.

The business also offers an all-in-one domains and hosting service, developing a client's website, registering its domain and hosting it under a single profile, plus company registration support and graphic design and print work from business cards to large-format PVC banners. Based in Erasmia, Centurion, Olive Designs & Web suits small businesses wanting their website, hosting, marketing and even company registration handled by one provider.

Phasecon has designed, manufactured and supported single- and three-phase thyristor controllers, DC drives and industrial rectifiers in South Africa since 1980, covering a current range from 20 amps to 2,000 amps. Its thyristor and furnace controllers provide precise power regulation for resistive loads, induction and arc furnaces and electric kilns, while its industrial rectifiers, available in air-cooled, oil-cooled and IGBT configurations, serve electroplating, electrolysis and other high-current DC processes.

The company's DC drives handle single and bi-directional motor control for conveyors, winders, rolling mills and crane systems, and it also replaces obsolete electronics with locally supported, custom-built alternatives for clients in steel, minerals, ceramics and heat treatment. Based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, Phasecon suits industrial operators needing thyristor control equipment designed and supported locally rather than imported with no local backup.

PostNet Thatchfield, in Thatchfield Retail Centre, Centurion, is a business services outlet offering copy and print, digital printing, stationery and certified document services alongside domestic and international courier options. Its courier range covers PostNet2PostNet and prepaid domestic delivery, PostNet2Door overnight, non-express and economy options, and international services through PostNet Global Express and DHL Express.

On the digital side, the branch offers internet stations, credit report access, email services and fax-to-email, giving customers business services beyond printing and courier alone. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm and Saturdays and public holidays from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays, PostNet Thatchfield suits residents and small businesses in Thatchfield Estate needing printing, courier and basic business services from one neighbourhood branch.

PVision, based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, has specialised in high-spec LED and LCD display ecosystems for commercial audio-visual projects since 2003, integrating intelligent hardware, engineered control systems and turnkey deployment into one streamlined solution. Its product range covers digital signage, LED displays, Tricolor displays and LCD displays, including Dahua digital signage and interactive whiteboards.

The company also supplies Brightsign media players and Nexmosphere proximity-triggered digital content systems, alongside vertical posters and interactive LCD monitors for retail and public-facing installations. Its services extend to control room design, custom LED applications, full installation, SLA support and complete turnkey project delivery. Based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, PVision suits businesses needing LED billboards, indoor or outdoor digital signage designed, installed and supported by one specialist.
